name: Pantry
tagline: Manage your pantry and avoid food waste
blurb: Dispensa helps you manage your pantry simply and efficiently.
description:
Dispensa helps you manage your pantry simply and efficiently.

Features:
• Add, edit, and remove items from your pantry
• Integration with Open Food Facts to automatically retrieve product information
• Receive notifications for expiring products
• Customizable locations to better organize your products
• Barcode scan to quickly add products
• Italian and English language support

Avoid food waste and always keep track of what you have in your pantry!
